QuestInfo.name: Panic in Hejin
QuestInfo.0: A member of the Beggar Guild told you about the threat to Hejin. Go to the village after talking to Xiao Xiao.
QuestInfo.2: Hejin was thrown into chaos as the shadowy outsiders made their way inside, which only increased the beasts' rage. A quick response prevented them from causing any serious damage.
